name: [400+ AVA!!] Mount Isenhold
desc:
🏰 Mount Isenhold  [ REVAMP ]
Difficulty: Medium (28 Checkpoints)
The first mountain map in Roblox to feature a free avatar.

Climb to the peak of Mount Isenhold and uncover the grandeur of Isenhold Castle, hidden among misty cliffs and rugged trails! 🏔️✨
Embark on an adventurous journey through rocky paths, mysterious forests, and hanging bridges that will test your courage.

🔥 Exciting Features:
👕 Try on medieval outfits and feel the spirit of the old kingdom!
🤝 Carry your friends along the journey and conquer obstacles together!
🐎 Ride a horse and explore the mountain like a true knight!
🎥 Activate Free Cam to enjoy the best cinematic views!
🌄 Experience breathtaking scenery from the mountain’s summit!

Are you ready to conquer Mount Isenhold and reach its legendary castle? ⚔️✨
